Package sets

Class SimpleSet

  • java.lang.Object
    • sets.SimpleSet
  • public class SimpleSet
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents an immutable set of points on the real line that is easy to describe, either because it is a finite set, e.g., {p1, p2, ..., pN}, or because it excludes only a finite set, e.g., R \ {p1, p2, ..., pN}. As with FiniteSet, each point is represented by a Java float with a non-infinite, non-NaN value.

      • SimpleSet

        public SimpleSet​(float[] vals)
        Creates a simple set containing only the given points.
        Parameters:
        vals - Array containing the points to make into a SimpleSet
        Effects:
        this = {vals[0], vals[1], ..., vals[vals.length-1]}
        Requires:
        points != null and has no NaNs, no infinities, and no dups

        public float size()
        Returns the number of points in this set.
        Returns:
        N if this = {p1, p2, ..., pN} and infty if this = R \ {p1, p2, ..., pN}

      • toString

        public java.lang.String toString()
        Returns a string describing the points included in this set.
        Overrides:
        toString in class java.lang.Object
        Returns:
        the string "R" if this contains every point, a string of the form "R \ {p1, p2, .., pN}" if this contains all but N > 0 points, or a string of the form "{p1, p2, .., pN}" if this contains N >= 0 points, where p1, p2, ... pN are replaced by the individual numbers. These floats will be turned into strings in the standard manner (the same as done by, e.g., String.valueOf(float)).
